title: gohrcat's Recipe Tweaks
description: Reworks many recipes and adds brand new ones all to make crafting easier and more accessible!
body:
# gohrcat's Recipe Tweaks Datapack!
**Ever wanted to use the Stonecutter to make Fences?**

**Ever wanted to get your Quartz back from the Quartz block you just crafted?**

_Well, I know a guy! ...or, rather, a datapack- this one!_

## Why use this datapack?

At the end of the day, you can use whatever datapack suits you, but I wanted to make the tweaks I thought were necessary. This datapack focuses mainly on rebalancing recipe yields and making some crafts more accessible via easier recipes or entirely new ones! I also designed it to work (mechanically) with any world- new or old (as in old worlds brought into newer versions- this pack is only compatible with newer versions). Most recipes remain fundamentally unchanged, but things like wood items and certain redstone components have some noticeable changes.

## What do these tweaks look like?

From things like were mentioned before to reworking the amount of items a recipe yields, there's something to like for everyone (although I wouldn't recommend you use this if you're a purist)!

**Here're a few examples:**

### More Buttons!
![Oak Plank giving 9 buttons rather than 1!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b59fd09272144d669e0c062c058ad4e5671f6237.png)

### Extended Stonecutter Usage!
![Making wooden blocks in the Stoncutter!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5c432b9bbf1099fd7af41a5a4bc3c34a9542fe2.png)

### Compact Smelting!
![Smelting full raw blocks!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b408848e5ab3ccb1fe36feb32bf1a4727b1c6fb3.png)

### Get (Some) Materials Back!
![Turning Amethyst blocks back in shards!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e485d134777c6954c0f1907c59ef6f3dea3d7a8.png)

_For a full changelog (all recipe tweaks and additions), visit the **Versions** page and click on the version you plan to download!_

More recipes will likely be tweaked/added in the future, especially as the updates progress, so keep an eye out!
